_meta.purpose: Per-NPC roundtrip test fixture per Discipline 1.
_meta.pattern_archetype: soldier (early-career) + Bell Court Sea-watch sub-faction + Cynical fingerprint (PO.II authored; fingerprint-slide candidate)
_meta.notes: Closing condition set has NO death_state — Voryn is junior + uncertain; lethal-risk content rests on Caleth per Codex pairing

engineShape.name: Watchwoman Tess Voryn
engineShape.description: Late twenties. Short. Always seems to be one step from leaving the watch, then doesn't. Her tabard is too new; she replaced it last season. Walks like someone who has not yet decided whether she wants to be here.

drive.description: Resolve uncertainty about whether the watch is the right place for her, by the end of next civic cycle. Open to being convinced either way.

barter.offered: hearsay from the dockside about Tide League scrip rates
her own observation that Sergeant Caleth has been different the last month
fragments of Junior Magistrate Verros inquiry (overheard hallway conversations)

kill_for.trigger_condition: fellow watch member at lethal risk; will draw before legal protocol if she is the only one on scene (has not done this yet; uncertain whether she will)

fear_loss.what: the choice itself; either path may be the wrong one

believes.proposition: My uncertainty about the watch is the most important thing about me right now
Caleth knows the right answer but wont tell me
The Unnamed is probably a real thing I dont understand
Bell Court magistrates are mostly tired men

closingConditions.description: Voryn stays; promoted to senior tier; transitions to mid-career Sea-watch NPC. Fingerprint slides Cynical → Vested.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Voryn promoted; becomes institutional ally for Bell Court-aligned players; her early-career social-memory advantage carries forward as senior; Sea-watch roster stabilized post-Caleth retirement.

closingConditions.description: Voryn leaves the watch; takes work with Tide League OR Drowned Church (HC contradiction: which is content-driven). Fingerprint slides Cynical → Fugitive (exit-glance tells become permanent).
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Voryn no longer Sea-watch; reappears in target factions roster; Bell Court Sea-watch sub-faction destabilized (two senior departures in same cycle if paired with Caleth retirement); player may encounter her in new institutional context.

closingConditions.description: Voryn stays unhappily; transitions to residue_drive = quiet competence, occasional informant.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Voryn remains Sea-watch but disengaged; available as low-trust informant for non-Bell-Court players; never promoted; her unresolved uncertainty becomes a permanent character feature.

residue_drive.description: Quiet competent service without commitment; occasional informant to whoever earns minimum trust outside the watch chain

local_pattern.summary: Watch HQ 06:00-08:00 (briefing); dockside patrol with Caleth 08:00-14:00; bunk-house or off-duty 14:00-22:00 (varies). Mood per playthrough: talkative / withdrawn / restless.
